FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY &
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160 014, INDIA
Advertisement for the walk-in interview for appointment of
Research associate (RA)
Candidates are invited for walk-in-interview on 16.4.2024 at 11.00 am in the office of the
Chairpeson Department of Chemistry Panjab University for one position of Research
associate (RA) in the DST-Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) sponsored
research project entitled “Development of NIR Emitting Peptide Conjugated Metallic
Nanoclusters for Effective Photothermal Therapy”sanctioned to the undersigned in
collaboration with IIT Hyderabad. Interested candidates may bring attested copies of
certificates, work experience and any other relevant certificates at the time of walk-in
interview.
Essential Qualifications for candidates:
Ph.D. degree (or Ph.D. thesis submitted) in the field of Chemistry / Organic Chemistry
/Medicinal Chemistry / Pharmaceutical Chemistry /Biotechnology/ Materials / Engineering /
Nanotechnology / allied branches
Desirable: Prior knowledge / experience of chemical synthesis of nanoconjugates and
biomolecules shall be preferable.
Salary: The selected candidate will be paid salary + HRA as per DST-SERB rules.
Duration: Initial appointment for one year, extendable up to three years based on
performance. The position is temporary and co-terminus with the project
Note: No TA / DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
Dr.Rohit Kumar Sharma
(Principal Investigator)
Department of Chemistry
Panjab University,
Sector-14 Chandigarh-160014
